question: The price of a computer is ₹22,200. What will be the price of the computer after reduction of 25%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The fractional value of 25% is 1/4. This implies a reduction of 1 part out of 4 total parts.

So, the new price becomes (4 − 1) ÷ 4 = 3/4 of the original price.

New Price = 3/4 × 22,200

New Price = 3 × 5,550 = 16,650

**∴ The correct answer is ₹16,650.**
